params.value_zh: 需搭配50L以上空压机使用

images_hint: 页面上方左侧机器照片(较小款),约占 x 8%-43% y 28%-58%;右侧大图为较大款(QG-3T500/999 共用)
advantages_zh: 全程自动完成取袋、开袋、计量、充填、封口、成品输出,无需人工干预。兼容预制袋、自立袋、真空袋等多种袋型,可快速切换不同规格。封口方式多样,密封牢固,可定制抽真空、充气等功能,有效锁鲜、防潮、防氧化,延长保质期。配置可视安全防护门、避免操作事故;可联动喷码等设备,满足追溯与合规要求。
advantages_en: The entire process, including bag picking, bag opening, metering, filling, sealing, and finished product output, is completed automatically without manual intervention. Compatible with various pre-made bag types such as stand-up pouches and vacuum bags, enabling quick switching between different specifications. Multiple sealing methods are available with firm sealing performance. Customizable functions like vacuum pumping and gas flushing are offered to effectively retain freshness, prevent moisture and oxidation, and extend shelf life. Equipped with visible safety protective doors to avoid operational accidents; can be linked with coding equipment to meet traceability and compliance requirements.
application_zh: 颗粒条形产品:五谷、坚果、茶叶、膨化零食、饲料、化肥、药材、红枣、瓜子、五金、饰品、咖啡豆、枸杞等;纯粉末产品:面粉、淀粉、玉米粉、豆粉、奶粉、咖啡粉、奶茶粉、益生菌粉、工业粉末、抹茶粉等;膏液产品:番茄酱、沙拉酱、果酱、凝胶、酱料、洗涤剂、水、花生酱、芝麻酱、蚝油等
application_en: Granular & strip products: grains, nuts, tea, puffed snacks, pet food, chemical fertilizer, medicinal herbs, red dates, melon seeds, hardware, accessories, coffee beans, wolfberries, etc. Powder products: flour, starch, corn powder, soybean powder, milk powder, coffee powder, milk tea powder, probiotic powder, industrial powder, matcha powder, etc. Paste & liquid products: tomato paste, salad dressing, jam, gel, sauces, laundry detergent, water, peanut butter, sesame paste, oyster sauce, etc.
notes: p135 为'按需定制 水平给袋式包装机 Pre-made Bag Packaging Machine'简介页(产品特性、主攻三大类产品、成品袋展示图),无参数表,归本机型;其 advantages/application 取自 p135。本页三个型号共用一张表,上方两张机器图:左图对应 QG-3T100,右图对应 QG-3T500/QG-3T999(依外形推测)。精准度英文列无单独英文,沿用中文'(因物料而异)'。 整机尺寸只印一个值 120x100x187cm(跨列),按图录入于 QG-3T100,QG-3T500/QG-3T999 无独立尺寸值,缺失:整机尺寸(未印)。气动需知跨三列共用一值。表下注:因机器外形和功能在不断的升级中,以上参数仅供参考,请以实际机型为准!(Note: Due to the continuous upgrading of the machine's appearance and functions, the above parameters are for reference only. Please refer to the actual model for accuracy!)
